pr_title: Implement ADR 0117 project-first Launcher and Editor lifecycle
pr_body:
Implements ADR 0117 across authoring, application lifecycle, Launcher, and Editor startup.

- BREAKING: bumps project.json to the next current-only schema and adds stable ProjectId plus explicit engine association. No legacy reader or migration is added, per ADR 0115.
- Adds the GUI-free engine-project-lifecycle crate for current-format compatibility, transactional standard project scaffolding, OS-backed per-canonical-location Editor leases, ephemeral ownership/readiness metadata, Launcher single-instance control, and lifecycle-only activation/close requests.
- Adds the separate engine-launcher executable with new/open/recent flows and process-replacement switching.
- Makes normal Editor startup require --project, acquire the authoritative project/lease before GUI bootstrap, and moves recent-project ownership out of Editor preferences.
- Updates the Windows launch scripts to build both desktop executables and start Launcher.

Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock change, so this PR requires full workspace Windows validation.
